title: The floating tool bar sits as tight as the mock draws it
goal: The tool bar floating over the canvas is now one glass bar like the video mock, but it is much looser: the mock packs its tools 4 points apart where the app leaves 14, so the bar is noticeably wider than the one the user drew and crowds the picture. The mock is the floor, so the bar should be at least as compact.
notes: From the rough list of queue/audits/2026-09-27-one-glass-tool-bar.json (task the-floating-tool-bar-is-one-glass-bar-as-the-mo, done 2026-09-27): 'The mock's bar is tighter: 4pt between tools where the app has 14pt, and 18pt hairlines where the app's are 20pt. The spacing inside the tools is unchanged by this task.' Pictures and recordings share the bar, so the change reaches both.
acceptance: At Next defaults the gap between tools on the floating bar matches the video mock's (4pt), and the hairlines are the mock's height (18pt)
Each tool keeps a hit target a person can land on without aiming, and hover still reads per tool
A walk photographs the bar beside the mock frame from docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit under queue/audits/ carries the side by side picture

log.note: Before building: the mock's .tool is 30pt wide 2pt apart (32pt step); app tools are 28pt circles, so 4pt gap keeps the step. Hairlines 18pt, 6pt from tools in a family (mock 2 gap + 4 margin), 8pt from sections (4 + 4). End padding 10 (concentric on the 48pt bar; mock 8 + 1 border on a 38pt bar). Current's capsules keep 14/20/18. Fit step now counts the tight 32pt slot (under-shedding otherwise). Walk one-glass-tool-bar-walk was failing on main before this change (read the recording before Cmd-2 put the bar up); added the Cmd-2 step. Walk now claims toolGap 4 and hairline 18, measured off every tool and hairline frame. Gotcha: wrapping a Divider in onGeometryChange made it lie flat and stretch the bar full width; the probe sits in a background. Filed p1: the-floating-tool-bar-is-as-short-as-the-mock-dr (48pt vs 38pt height, slider 110 vs 92). 11 tool-bar walks pass; Scripts/test.sh 10430 tests pass.

Next's one glass bar spaces tools 4pt apart (the mock's 32pt step), 18pt hairlines 6/8pt from their neighbours, 10pt ends (EditorChromeLayout.ToolBarSpacing, tested; fit step uses the tight slot). one-glass-tool-bar-walk claims toolGap 4 and hairline 18 at Next defaults and passes, plus 10 other tool-bar walks; Scripts/test.sh green.
